title: Example Network — Three Kingdoms Mini Map

nodes.label: Cao Cao
nodes.bio: Warlord of the north, founder of the Wei state. Known for political pragmatism and military tactics.

nodes.label: Liu Bei
nodes.bio: Distant Han royal who founded Shu Han. Famous for his benevolent leadership style.

nodes.label: Sun Quan
nodes.bio: Heir to the Sun family in the southeast. Consolidated Wu through diplomacy and naval power.

nodes.label: Zhuge Liang
nodes.title: Chancellor of Shu Han, master strategist.

nodes.label: Zhou Yu
nodes.title: Wu's grand commander at the Battle of Red Cliffs.

edges.label: rivals
edges.title: Long-standing political and military rivalry across northern China.

edges.label: allied
edges.title: Allied against Cao Cao at the Battle of Red Cliffs (208 AD).

edges.label: recruits
edges.title: Liu Bei recruited Zhuge Liang via the 'three visits to the thatched cottage'.
